items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: our mothers and forefathers used to sing, Bessie Smith used to sing 8 bar blues man.

ctx.x: Have you listened to the top 40 jazz albums recently?

No, not recently. You see our blues, man, we don't even play our 8-bar blues no more. What happened to the 8-bar blues? What happened to it? Man, our mothers and forefathers used to sing, Bessie Smith used to sing 8 bar blues man. What happened to it? What happened to the minors? A lot of our music used to be in minors, man, because the minors give you the real feeling of expressing yourself in the minors, man.
